# Aeronautics: Conquering the Wild

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gQ0tdX70/images/6aa9cf5b2a3b6d0d75d429079fb95ef224097ef0_350.webp)

Aeronautics: Conquering the Wild is a modpack centered around the **Create Aeronautics** mod, with an emphasis on navigating terrain generated by **Terralith** and **Tectonica**.

The pack includes multiple **Create** and **Aeronautics addons** to expand building options, and is optimized for a multiplayer experience. You will build operational airships to explore large-scale world generation, manage logistics, and map the expansive landscape.
